messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline finished for release v1.14.2-canary -> canary cluster
lisa: seeing garbled output from canary... short sequences, repeated tokens :confused:
jamal: can you paste a sample? also which model variant did this hit?
lisa: here's a sample from canary logs:
```
2026-03-11T09:12:03Z | req 0x7f2 | model: redwood-gpt-7B-q4_0
input: "Summarize the quarterly earnings"
output: "ĠĠĠNULLNULLNULL"
```
mike: paging oncall
oncall: I'm on it, paging SRE, setting sev=high until we know impact :rotating_light:
ops_incident_bot: Pager: incident created (sev:high) — responders: oncall, jamal
jamal: check model hash & tokenizer bundle on the canary nodes
lisa: quick check: model hash in manifest `sha256:abc123...` but deployed weights say `sha256:abf129...` — mismatch?
mike: canary traffic rate small but customer-facing routes were routed to canary due to routing policy change :grimacing:
jamal: confirm tokenizer metadata shows vocab_version=20260305 vs expected 20260227
mike: flipping kill-switch for the canary rollout now (feature flag: `deploy.rollout.v1_14_2.canary=false`)
```
# action
curl -X POST https://console.internal/flags/deploy.rollout.v1_14_2.canary -d '{"value":false}'
```
lisa: acknowledged, flag flipped — traffic draining from canary
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered: release v1.14.2 -> previous stable v1.14.1 (initiated by mike)
lisa: rollback in progress across all canary hosts; starting weights re-attach and tokenizer sync
deploy-bot: Rollback complete on 8/8 canaries — traffic now on v1.14.1
csm_amy: any customer-facing errors? heard a brief spike on support
lisa: short blip on error rate for 2 minutes, <0.1% of requests saw garbled tokens. no active customer incidents reported yet
jamal: root cause looks like artifact promotion script picked up a weight bundle from staging with a non-matching tokenizer, plus a config drift in artifact metadata
mike: note: we disabled auto-promote for the pipeline, adding a validation gate to compare model hash + tokenizer hash before promote
oncall: great, log me for postmortem. Severity reduced to low, will close when RCA doc is up
lisa: opening incident ticket now and tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml
jamal: for next steps: add a canary-only checksum validator and a pre-promote dry-run
csm_amy: I'll reach out to any customers who reported issues with a short summary
mike: thanks all, nice fast kill-switch flip. follow up tomorrow with timeline and remediation PRs
oncall: closing handoff — handback to oncall-next in 2h
:thumbsup:
